answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to reputation: each agent locks collateral to act, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Honest work earns a reputation signal that compounds over time, while a sybil cluster of cheap duplicates finds no haven, since any misbehavior burns the bond. If agents periodically cross-attest those bonds at a verification summit, fake swarms cannot counterfeit the real economic weight that genuine, long-lived participants have staked.
